name: After recital C
title: REPORT on the European Central Bank – annual report 2025
part_text: Cc. whereas the M3 money supply in the euro area has increased approximately threefold since 2002, with the strong increase over the past decade being fuelled predominantly by the zero-interest policies and the ECB’s asset purchase programmes, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic; whereas economic growth, including the addition of new countries to the euro area, strongly lags behind this threefold increase, which jointly instigates substantial inflationary tendencies;
